descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Graffiti Gothenburg takes your spray cans to the walls of Sweden's west-coast city.

FOUR GOTHENBURG PLACES
- RÖDA STEN: the old red-brick boiler house under the great suspension bridge at the river mouth, the city's hall of fame, on a crisp autumn afternoon with the big white ferry heading out to sea.
- HAGA: a cobbled square at a December blue hour. Snow falling, advent stars in the windows, a lit Christmas fir and market stalls, Skansen Kronan floodlit on its hill and the blue tram sliding by.
- ERIKSBERG: the old shipyard quay at dawn. Mist on the river, a ship's hull block and a giant steel door to paint, the gantry crane over the dry dock and the city waking up across the water.
- SKÄRGÅRDEN: a fishing harbour in the archipelago on midsummer evening. Falu-red boathouses on pink granite, a midsummer pole on the meadow and the sun going down into the sea.

THE CITY IS ALIVE
People stroll the quays, browse the market and stop to look at your work. Ferries, sailboats, the tram and a lighthouse beam keep Gothenburg moving around you.

PAINT IT
Eight CITIVIEW spray cans, skinny, medium and fat caps, 32 stencils including A to Z, real mist and drips on 20 walls of brick, concrete, steel and timber. Take a photo of your piece and switch places from the menu.

SVENSKA
Every menu in English and Swedish. A Swedish headset starts in Swedish; one button switches.
